pages.en: Mum has lots to do in town today. First she takes Lily and Tom to the dentist. Their teeth are fine!
pages.zh: 妈妈今天在城里有很多事要办。她先带 Lily 和 Tom 去看牙医。他们的牙齿都很好！
pages.scene: A bright dentist's room, a kind dentist smiling at Tom in the big chair, Lily and Mum standing next to him.

pages.en: Then they go to the post office with a present for Grandma, and to the library for some new books.
pages.zh: 然后他们去邮局给奶奶寄礼物，又去图书馆借了几本新书。
pages.scene: Mum handing a wrapped present across the counter in a post office, Lily and Tom holding library books under their arms.

pages.en: At last they have lunch at a restaurant. "What a busy day!" says Tom. "Now let's go to the swimming pool!"
pages.zh: 最后他们在一家餐馆吃午饭。“今天真忙啊！”Tom 说，“现在我们去游泳池吧！”
pages.scene: Mum, Lily and Tom eating lunch at a table in a friendly restaurant, Tom pointing out of the window at a swimming pool building.

questions.q: They send a present to Grandpa.
They have lunch at a restaurant.
